data.name: Dilkhush
data.gender_notes: Dilkhush is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit roots ‘dil’ meaning heart and ‘khus’ meaning delight, pleasure. In Hindu mythology, Dilkhush is a name that evokes joy and happiness. It is believed that those named Dilkhush are blessed with a delightful and pleasurable existence. The name Dilkhush carries the meaning “Delight, pleasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dilkhush usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May your heart be filled with joy and pleasure.
data.etymology: Dilkhush belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, pleasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dilkhush total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

historical_references.reference: Dilkhush was a title given to the governors of the provinces of Gujarat and Malwa during the Mughal Empire.
The name 'Dilkhush' signifies 'pleasing the heart' in Persian and was a title of esteem and honour bestowed upon the governors.

On social media, it is used as a hashtag for posts and stories that evoke happiness and joy. On online dating apps, it is a unique and appealing name for profiles, especially for those looking for a partner who brings happiness and positivity into their life. On baby naming websites, it is a top choice for parents who want to give their child a name that symbolizes joy and happiness.
